title: Extend the song to make it longer

body.text: If the song is too short, use
from the point you want, and Suno continues it smoothly. Use it to build a full-length song from a section you like, or add an Outro that gradually fades out.

example: Extend from 1:20 → add a [Bridge], then a [Chorus] and an [Outro] that gradually softens

title: Try several versions and choose

body.text: Each time you Create, Suno gives you
to choose from, and you can re-generate as many times as you like. The trick is to keep the closest one and tweak the prompt a little at a time, rather than redoing everything.

example: You like the Chorus melody but want a slower Verse → change only the tempo word in Style, then generate again
